title: DIR-076: Remediate Command Palette Search Bar Focus Outline Visual Defect
spec: P0 VISUAL & ARCHITECTURAL MANDATES: 1. ELIMINATE RECTANGULAR FOCUS OUTLINE FROM SEARCH INPUT: In src/index.css lines 122-130, input:focus-visible forces 'outline: 2px solid #4f46e5 !important; outline-offset: 2px !important;'. This overrides Tailwind's outline-none on CubaCommandPalette's <input>, causing an ugly, sharp-cornered purple rectangular box to render inside the rounded command palette pill when focused. Update src/index.css to except seamless inputs: input:not([data-seamless='true']):not(.cuba-seamless-input):focus-visible { ... } and add an explicit override: .cuba-seamless-input:focus, .cuba-seamless-input:focus-visible { outline: none !important; outline-offset: 0 !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: none !important; background: transparent !important; }. 2. UNIFIED SEAMLESS SEARCH BAR IN CUBACOMMANDPALETTE: In src/components/cuba/CubaCommandPalette.jsx line 567, add data-seamless='true' and className containing 'cuba-seamless-input' to the <input> element. Ensure the outer container (data-testid='cuba-command-searchbar') acts as the sole, unified focus ring using Cuba tokens (Linear / Spotlight style), embracing FiSearch, input, and Esc as one unified rounded surface without any nested borders, outlines, or boxes. 3. VERIFICATION: Add unit regression assertion confirming the input carries data-seamless='true' and cuba-seamless-input. Verify build under 4s, 0 lint errors, and all pinned suites pass.

UX STATES: this pure styling change leaves the palette CubaSkeleton loading state, its empty state and its error banner untouched. RESPONSIVE: validated at the 375px mobile, 768px tablet and 1280px desktop breakpoints; the bar is a flex row that already wraps at narrow widths.
